out.detail: lower body injury (misses remainder of season)

away.summary: The Rangers are 5-2-0 and will face the Devils after a strong home stretch, having won all four games at MSG this season. They will start Dylan Garand in goal as Igor Shesterkin, Joonas Korpisalo, and Joseph Veleno are all out with lower-body injuries. The team is tied for the league lead in wins and goal differential, and leads the NHL in first- and third-period goal differential.

returning: : Jonathan Kovacevic (season debut, replacing Dillon in lineup)
: Jesper Noesen (entering lineup in place of Evangelista)
home.summary: The Devils are 2-3-0 and will host the Rangers after a 4-1 loss to Ottawa. They are projected to start Nico Daws in goal, with Jake Allen as backup. Connor Brown, Nick Bjugstad, and Luke Evangelista are out, while Jonathan Kovacevic will make his season debut and Jesper Noesen returns to the lineup. The team held no morning skate following their loss.
